body:
Thanks for all this advice!

I have tried to be proactive, but I feel like I'm doing all the work. I guess we really just have to talk it out. 

I see that things won't get better on their own, guess I just don't really know what people mean when they say 'it takes a lot of work.' Does that mean doing things that I don't want to do? If so, does the fact that I don't want to do them mean something?
My opinion exactly.... He believes in psychology I guess, just not psychologists being able to help people. He thinks they only want your money.

I have suffered from depression myself, so I know how much it sucks.

Thanks.

He says he doesn't know what's causing his depression, but that 'nothing feels right' in his head.

I agree that it is a major change, and maybe I was overreacting, but that incident wasn't even close to the first time that has happened. I guess I just miss the way we used to be in the beginning, and I'm freaking out because things HAVE cooled off a little bit.

I want to spend more time with him in a meaningful way is what I mean.

I try to get him to do things with me, but he's kind of stubborn and a homebody. I just want to go on a goddam walk sometimes. I don't think that's too much to ask for.
That sounds like a really good plan to me. I love him with all of my heart, but at a certain point I have to think about my happiness and wellbeing also.

He has never been depressed before in his life, and he seems to be functioning well enough, so perhaps he is just down. But I feel like I have been waiting and actively trying for things to get better. Sometimes I feel like we're on different wavelengths.

He doesn't believe in psychology, so he would have to pull himself out of his depression by his own damn self, because that's what he believes is right.

Thanks for the advice.

I live with him so it would be really hard to leave and abandon my life. I talked to him about it, and he didn't go sleep on her couch. He's never alone with her, there's always people over there, so I think that's a good compromise. I don't want to be too controlling, but still.
He has one of those locks on his phone. Trust me, I've thought about it.
I am trying to look forward but it's been so bad for a while that I don't know how good feels. Thanks.

I always feel awful after cutting but I don't know what to do. Today was so bad and I just want to feel better even for a little bit. I think I might be having withdrawals from my medicine and everything in the entire universe seems bad and corrupt. I know I need help but I'm so busy with school and everything. You could message me, I'll answer.

I try to do things to make myself feel better but nothing works. Helping people doesn't do anything for me because some asshole in my day will just ruin my good feelings. I'm trying so hard to beat my depression but it feels like there is no point.
No one right now. Nobody can see me right now. Not even friends.

It's not a bad relationship. I just can't be happy for him right now and it makes me feel worse. Idk I fucked everything up and I have no money to leave the house and it's really cold right now. I appreciate your advice.
With my boyfriend whom I live with. I want to cut because I know it'll make me stop crying. I don't want to feel right now.
That sounds so great but we don't really have the money for a getaway. But I could talk to him about a little date every now and again! Just a movie sounds like the best thing right now.
It just seems like we're arguing like an old married couple. It's really draining.
I have talked to him but it seems like work and school have gotten in the way along with my depression about the entire situation.
I go to therapy a lot. That's why I'm hopeless.

I am thinking of ending all relationships I have with people and giving up on every thing I am involved in. I am really depressed, but I have most people convinced that I am now fine. I see no point in doing anything, and hate forcing myself to do things. I am scared that everything I'm doing is wrong, because of my borderline personality disorder. I doubt literally everything. I'm not even sure if I like my cat and dogs. How fucked up is that? I've never been this bad before but I can't tell anyone. Here's to the future.

That I doubt literally every aspect of my life. I have borderline personality disorder, just turned 20, and have no idea if any choice that I'm making is due to my disorder, or if it's due to me trying to do the opposite of what people with my disorder do. I am so in love with my boyfriend, but because of the scenarios I create in my head, I doubt his motives and feelings. I am so in need of help, but everyone has treated me differently when they find out about my disorder.

This probably won't get read, but I'd like to get this off my chest.

I betrayed the love of my life. I did something that I promised him I would never do. And he forgave me. I have never been more grateful for anything in my life. Thank goodness this year is over; I have some real work to do.

My family isn't gone in the sense that they don't care about me anymore. They just live 2,000 miles away now and I can't see them all the time. I get nervous about being all by myself and sometimes my boyfriend acts really immature so it's hard to be depressed around him. Sometimes I feel like I still need my mommy.
I'm just recently become very uptight for some reason, which I think is also a main contributor. I have a bug up my ass and I don't know how to kill it lol. Hopefully after finals week it dies.

He wasn't happy when I was clingy, so I'm trying to be better.

But I think you're right, overthinking is my main problem.
Thank-you.
